findings_qualitative.value: Axis ratio distribution lacks round sources, matches spheroids but Sérsic index matches discs, consistent with bars

evidence.quote: the axis ratio distribution of SMGs is most similar to those of spheroid galaxies, while their Sérsic index distribution is most similar to that of disc galaxies.

findings_qualitative.value: Extended component's luminosity roughly constant with SFR while compact component brightens

evidence.quote: the size and luminosity of the extended component is roughly constant with total star-formation rate, while the compact component becomes brighter.

claims.hypothesis: Are SMG dust continuum morphologies consistent with randomly oriented discs?
claims.experiment: Compared b/a distribution with thick/thin disc and triaxial models using KS and AIC
claims.result: Discs rejected (KS 0%); triaxial has KS 40% and lowest AIC
claims.finding: SMG emission is triaxial with n~1, bar-like

evidence.quote: We conclude that the “deficit” in high axis ratios is most likely due to intrinsic triaxial morphologies

claims.hypothesis: Is there faint extended dust emission around the compact starburst?
claims.experiment: Stacked 870um maps in uv and image planes
claims.result: Extended component on ~0.5'' scales with 13±1% of flux
claims.finding: Extended disc/envelope similar to CO and stellar light

evidence.quote: we also clearly detect faint and extended emission on $\geq 0.5\ensuremath{''}$ scales

claims.hypothesis: Do SMG sizes evolve with redshift or flux?
claims.experiment: Plotted Reff against z and S870
claims.result: Weak decline with z, marginal increase with S870
claims.finding: Physical sizes do not evolve strongly

evidence.quote: The weak decline in size we see with redshift suggests that the physical sizes of SMGs do not evolve strongly with redshift

why_this_data.value: Cycle 3 0.18'' data with S/N>8 give reliable sizes and shapes

evidence.quote: This selection should ensure we can measure robust sizes and shapes for these sources

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Optically thick and thin circular disc models rejected as they need unphysical biased viewing angles

evidence.quote: neither of the circular disc models is able to adequately fit the data without invoking assumptions of unphysical viewing angle biases

limitations_admitted.value: Resolution and depth insufficient to directly detect bars; higher resolution needed

evidence.quote: to confirm this requires deeper observations to detect the extended components in individual maps, higher resolution imaging ($\sim0.08\ensuremath{''}$)
